facts.fact: Pulse Kenya reports that eCitizen runs OAuth and single sign-on authentication infrastructure that helps connected services verify users, which VECERT raised concerns about possible unauthorised access to; the claim is unconfirmed.
Pulse Kenya says eCitizen's OAuth and single sign-on infrastructure serves connected services, not one system alone.

systems.platform: government services platform with OAuth and SSO
systems.owner: State Department for Immigration and Citizen Services
